vocab.meaning: v. to be called, to call

vocab.example_cn: I live at the Wang family.
I live at the Wang family.

reading.en: 我叫大卫。我是学生。我来北京。我住在王家。王阿姨是妈妈。王叔叔是爸爸。小明和小红在家。
reading.cn: My name is David. I am a student. I came to Beijing. I live with the Wang family. Aunt Wang is the mother. Uncle Wang is the father. Xiaoming and Xiaohong are at home.

grammar.title: 叫 (to be called)
grammar.explain: Use '叫' to say a name. Structure: Subject + 叫 + Name.

grammar.title: 是 (to be) for identification
grammar.explain: '是' links a subject and a noun (identity or role). Structure: A + 是 + B.

grammar.title: 住 / 在 (to live / at location)
grammar.explain: '住' or '住在' describes where someone lives. '在' can show location (at/in).

examples.cn: I live at the Wang family.

fillBlanks.cn: I live at the Wang family.

listening.audio: 我叫大卫。我是学生。我来北京。我住在王家。王阿姨是妈妈。王叔叔是爸爸。小明和小红在家。

output.prompt: Introduce yourself to your host family in Chinese. Write 2-3 short sentences (name, where you are from or that you live here).
output.cn: Introduce yourself to your host family in Chinese. Write 2-3 short sentences (name, where you are from or that you live here).
output.sample: 我叫大卫。我住在王家。很高兴认识你们。

reading.note: Jīn tiān shì dì yī tiān.
Rèn shí nǐ hěn gāo xìng.

grammar.title: 是 (to be) — identity
grammar.explain: Use 是 to say what someone/something is (identity or profession). Structure: A 是 B.

grammar.title: 叫 (to be called) — name
grammar.explain: Use 叫 to say someone's name. Structure: 我叫 + name.

grammar.title: 很 + adjective — degree (very)
grammar.explain: 很 before an adjective shows degree. Common phrase: 很高兴 (very happy / pleased).

quiz.q: What is David's role at the university?
Which phrase does David use to say he is happy to meet someone?

listening.audio: 今天是第一天。我在大学。我是学生。我叫大卫。我来自美国。我有朋友。认识你很高兴。

output.prompt: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences to introduce yourself to a new classmate (say your name, where you are from, and say nice to meet you).
output.cn: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences to introduce yourself to a new classmate (say your name, where you are from, and say nice to meet you).
output.sample: 你好！我叫大卫。我来自美国。我是学生。认识你很高兴。

vocab.meaning: v. to look; to show (给...看)

reading.cn: He shows them to Aunt Wang.

grammar.title: “这是” (identification)
grammar.explain: Use 这是 + noun to identify or introduce someone/something.

grammar.title: “有” (possession / there is)
grammar.explain: Use 有 after a noun/pronoun to say someone has something or there is/are something.

grammar.title: “的” (possessive)
grammar.explain: Use 的 after a pronoun or noun to show possession: 我的 = my, 他的 = his, etc.

quiz.q: Who does David show the photos to?
Which family members are named in the photos?

listening.audio: 大卫在家。他有照片。他给王阿姨看。这是我的家人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。王阿姨笑了。

output.prompt: Write 2 short Chinese sentences to introduce two family members (use 这是 and 我的).
output.cn: Write 2 short Chinese sentences introducing two family members using 这是 and 我的.
output.sample: 这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。

vocab.example_cn: She is in the United States.
She is in the United States.

vocab.meaning: v. to not have; there is not

reading.en: 我有一个姐姐。她在美国。她叫丽莎。王阿姨有两个孩子。小明没有姐姐。小红有姐姐。
reading.cn: I have an older sister. She is in the United States. Her name is Lìshā. Aunt Wang has two children. Xiaoming doesn't have a sister. Xiaohong has a sister.
reading.note: Short, simple sentences — look at the new words in the vocab list.

grammar.title: 有 / 没有 (have / not have)
grammar.explain: Use 有 to say someone has something. Use 没有 to say someone does not have something.

examples.cn: Xiaoming does not have a sister.

grammar.title: 一个 / 两个 (measure word 个)
grammar.explain: Use a number + 个 to count people or objects: 一个 = one, 两个 = two.

grammar.title: 在 + place (location)
grammar.explain: Use 在 before a place to say where someone/something is.

examples.cn: She is in the United States.

expressions.cn: Do you have an older brother?
I don't have a younger brother.

quiz.q: How many children does Aunt Wang have?
Who does NOT have a sister?
What is the passage mainly about?

listening.audio: 我有一个姐姐。她在美国。她叫丽莎。王阿姨有两个孩子。小明没有姐姐。小红有姐姐。

output.prompt: Write 2-3 simple Chinese sentences about your siblings (use 我, 有, 没有, 一个, 两个, 姐姐, 哥哥, 弟弟, 妹妹, 在).
output.cn: Write 2-3 simple Chinese sentences about your siblings (use 我, 有, 没有, 一个, 两个, 姐姐, 哥哥, 弟弟, 妹妹, 在).
output.sample: 我有一个妹妹。她在家。她叫小花。

vocab.example_cn: Uncle Wang works at the hospital.
Uncle Wang works at the hospital.
Xiaoming and Xiaohong are at home.

reading.en: 我住在北京。我跟王阿姨住。我的爸爸是医生。王叔叔在医院工作。小明和小红在家。
reading.cn: I live in Beijing. I live with Aunt Wang. My dad is a doctor. Uncle Wang works at the hospital. Xiaoming and Xiaohong are at home.
reading.note: Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng. Wǒ gēn Wáng āyí zhù. Wǒ de bàba shì yīshēng. Wáng shūshu zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Xiǎo Míng hé Xiǎo Hóng zài jiā.

grammar.title: 是 (shì) — 'to be' sentences
grammar.explain: Use 是 to say what someone or something is. The structure: Subject + 是 + noun.

grammar.title: 在 (zài) — location / 'at' and ongoing actions
grammar.explain: 在 shows location or that someone is doing something at a place. Structure: Subject + 在 + place + (verb).

examples.cn: Uncle Wang works at the hospital.

grammar.title: 跟 (gēn) — 'with'
grammar.explain: 跟 is used to say 'with'. Structure: Subject + 跟 + someone + verb.

quiz.q: Who does the speaker live with?

listening.audio: 我住在北京。我跟王阿姨住。我的爸爸是医生。王叔叔在医院工作。小明和小红在家。

output.prompt: Write 3 short Chinese sentences: say where you live, who you live with, and your dad's job.
output.cn: Write 3 short Chinese sentences: say where you live, who you live with, and your dad's job.
output.sample: 我住在北京。我跟妈妈住。我的爸爸是医生。

vocab.meaning: v. to eat; to have a meal

vocab.example_cn: Aunt Wang said: Please come to eat.

reading.en: 今天我们一起吃饭。王阿姨说：请来吃饭。王叔叔在家。小明和小红在。大卫来了。饭很好吃。
reading.cn: Tonight we eat together. Aunt Wang says: Please come to eat. Uncle Wang is at home. Xiao Ming and Xiao Hong are here. David came. The food is very tasty.
reading.note: Short scene: family dinner. (Pinyin not shown here; focus on characters.)

grammar.title: 一起 (yì qǐ) — 'together'
grammar.explain: 一起 + verb means doing something together. Common with 我们.

grammar.title: 在 (zài) — location
grammar.explain: 在 + place shows where someone is (location).

grammar.title: 请 (qǐng) — invite / please
grammar.explain: Use 请 to invite or politely ask someone to do something.

examples.cn: Aunt Wang says: Please come to eat.

fillBlanks.cn: Aunt/Uncle Wang says please come to eat.

listening.audio: 今天我们一起吃饭。王阿姨说：请来吃饭。王叔叔在家。小明和小红在。大卫来了。饭很好吃。

output.prompt: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences inviting someone to eat together with your family. Use words like 我们, 一起, 吃饭, 请, 来, 家.
output.cn: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences inviting someone to eat together with your family. Use words like 我们, 一起, 吃饭, 请, 来, 家.
output.sample: 我们一起吃饭吧。请来家里吃饭。

grammar.title: 喜欢 (to like)
grammar.explain: Use Subject + 喜欢 + noun/verb. '喜欢' expresses preference.

grammar.title: 在 (location)
grammar.explain: '在' is used to say where someone is: Subject + 在 + place.

grammar.title: 一起 (together)
grammar.explain: '一起' means doing something together: Subject + 一起 + verb.

quiz.q: What does David like to drink?

listening.audio: 大卫在家。王阿姨做茶。我喜欢喝茶。小明喝牛奶。小红吃面包。我们一起吃。

output.prompt: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences about what you like to drink for breakfast at home.
output.cn: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences about what you like to drink for breakfast at home.
output.sample: 我在家。早上我喜欢喝茶。我也喝牛奶。

vocab.meaning: v. to want (to do something); to think

reading.en: 今天中午。王阿姨请客。我们去饭店。服务员来了。我想吃米饭。小明要饺子。王叔叔说：请给我菜单。
reading.cn: This noon. Aunt Wang treats. We go to the restaurant. The waiter came. I want to eat rice. Xiaoming wants dumplings. Uncle Wang says: Please give me the menu.

grammar.title: 想 + verb
grammar.explain: Use 想 before a verb to say you want or would like to do something.

grammar.title: 要 and 不要
grammar.explain: 要 means 'to want' or 'to need'. 不要 is the negative 'do not want'.

examples.cn: I don't want to drink water.

grammar.title: 请 (polite request)
grammar.explain: Put 请 before a verb to make a polite request: 'please ...'.

expressions.cn: Excuse me, how much is this?

quiz.q: Where do they go to eat?
What does the narrator say they want to eat?

listening.audio: 今天中午。王阿姨请客。我们去饭店。服务员来了。我想吃米饭。小明要饺子。王叔叔说：请给我菜单。

output.prompt: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences (HSK1 words) about what you want to eat at a restaurant.
output.cn: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences (HSK1 words) about what you want to eat at a restaurant.
output.sample: 我想吃米饭。我要饺子。请给我菜单。

vocab.meaning: v. to give / to see off / to deliver
v. to attend class; class starts

grammar.title: Time words before the verb
grammar.explain: In Chinese, time expressions usually come before the verb. Put the time (like '八点' or '今天') before the verb to say when something happens.

examples.cn: I go to school at eight o'clock.

grammar.title: 去 + place (go to a place)
grammar.explain: Use 去 + place to say you go to a place.

examples.cn: Auntie Wang takes me to school.

quiz.q: How does David feel about school?

listening.audio: 今天我去学校。我八点去。王阿姨送我。我去上课。老师很好。我喜欢学校。

output.prompt: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences about when you go to school. Use words from the lesson (e.g., 今天, 八点, 学校, 去).
output.cn: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences about when you go to school (use lesson words).
output.sample: 今天我八点去学校。王阿姨送我。老师很好。

vocab.example_cn: Teacher, please slow down a little.
Please say it again (one more time).

reading.cn: Teacher, please speak a little slower.

grammar.title: 请 + verb (polite request)
grammar.explain: Use 请 before a verb to make a polite request.

grammar.title: 再 + verb + 一遍 (do again)
grammar.explain: Use 再 + verb + 一遍 to ask someone to do something again one more time.

grammar.title: 不 + verb (negation)
grammar.explain: Use 不 before a verb to make it negative: do not / do not understand.

quiz.q: Where does the scene take place?
How does the teacher speak at first?
What does David ask the teacher?

listening.audio: 今天中文课。老师说话快。大卫不懂。他问老师。老师，请再说一遍。老师请慢一点。我现在懂了。

output.prompt: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences to ask the teacher to repeat and say you understand.
output.cn: Write 2-3 short Chinese sentences to ask the teacher to repeat and say you understand.
output.sample: 老师，请再说一遍。我不懂。谢谢老师。我现在懂了。

vocab.example_cn: I live at Aunt Wang's house.
I live at Aunt Wang's house.

reading.en: 我在北京。 我住在王阿姨家。 今天一个月了。 我很高兴。 我有新朋友。 我喜欢北京菜。
reading.cn: I'm in Beijing. I live at Aunt Wang's house. Today it's been one month. I am very happy. I have new friends. I like Beijing food.

grammar.title: 在 + place (location)
grammar.explain: Use 在 before a place to show location: '在 + 地方'.

examples.cn: I live at Aunt Wang's house.

grammar.title: 很 + adjective (intensifier)
grammar.explain: 很 goes before adjectives to show degree. For simple talk, 很 + adj is common.

grammar.title: 有 (have / there is)
grammar.explain: 有 shows possession or existence. 'Subject + 有 + object'.

quiz.q: How long has David been in Beijing?

listening.audio: 我在北京。我住在王阿姨家。今天一个月了。我很高兴。我有新朋友。我喜欢北京菜。

output.prompt: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences about how you feel after one month in a new place (use words like 我, 在, 很, 高兴, 家, 朋友, 一个).
output.cn: Write 2–3 short Chinese sentences about how you feel after one month in a new place (use words like 我, 在, 很, 高兴, 家, 朋友, 一个).
output.sample: 我在北京一个月了。我很高兴。我有新朋友。
